en.headline: Five vehicles collide in Sham Shui Po after taxi hits motorcycle
en.dek: Police said a 25-year-old motorcyclist suffered a leg injury and a 67-year-old taxi driver reported discomfort after the crash on Castle Peak Road; both were conscious and taken to Caritas Hospital.
body: Police said a traffic accident involving five vehicles occurred on Castle Peak Road near No. 60 in Sham Shui Po at about 10:20pm on Tuesday.

A taxi is suspected to have collided with a motorcycle that was changing lanes, knocking the rider down, before hitting two private cars. Dashcam footage circulated online showed the sequence of the collision.

The 25-year-old motorcyclist sustained a leg injury, and the 67-year-old taxi driver reported feeling unwell. Both remained conscious and were taken by ambulance to Caritas Hospital for treatment. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 深水埗青山道的士撞電單車醒五車相撞 兩人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示星期二晚上約10時20分於深水埗青山道60號對開發生五車相撞，25歲鐵騎士腳部受傷，67歲的士司機報稱不適，兩人清醒送明愛醫院。
body: 警方表示，星期二晚上約10時20分，深水埗青山道近60號對開發生一宗涉及五輞車輞的交通意外。
一輞的士懷疑與一輞正在轉線的電單車相撞，將鐵騎士撞倒地面，其後再撞向兩輞私家車。網上流傳的行車記錄錄低顯示了相撞過程。
25歲鐵騎士腳部受傷，67歲的士司機報稱身體不適。兩人均保持清醒，由救護車送往明愛醫院接受治理。警方正調查意外原因。
